_comment: Declared on-host secret files for indri: the main forgejo runner's
identity, the indri-build runner's identity, and the heph hub's
authorized-sub (the ringtail agent spoke's talos-heph OIDC sub), all
seated by `mise run seed-secrets indri` (human-run on gilbert, biometric
1Password). Each runner's postActivation render assembles its config.yaml
from its files plus forge/runners.json; a content change kickstarts the
runner. The indri-build runner's identity is root-owned under
/usr/local/etc/forgejo-runner-build/identity/ (root:wheel 0600, outside
the build home) so seed-secrets never root-writes into the
attacker-controlled home: only the generation's postActivation (as
root) reads the files to render the config; the indri-build daemon
reads only config.yaml. Its entries declare no restart: the daemon is
in the system launchd domain, which seed-secrets' Darwin restart leg
(per-user gui domains) cannot kick - the generation's postActivation
render and its kickstart cover re-seeds at the next apply. The heph
hub's store
wrapper cats its file into hephd's argv at startup (argv-only flag,
eblume/blumeops#1655); its entry's restart kicks the agent label on
re-seed.
The file existing is what the flake invariant (darwin/indri/
invariants.nix) reads, so the lockstep guard protects both directions.
Metadata only, no values.
eblume/blumeops#1524; eblume/blumeops#1528; eblume/blumeops#1655;
eblume/blumeops#1627; docs/reference/operations/declared-state-files.md
